en.headline: Super Terminal Expo opens at AsiaWorld-Expo focusing on future transport hubs
en.dek: The three-day event organised by Informa Markets runs from 3 to 5 November with Hong Kong International Airport as principal partner, covering terminal design, automation and low-altitude economy.
body: Super Terminal Expo 2026 opens today at AsiaWorld-Expo, bringing together authorities, airport operators, rail and logistics providers to discuss the design and operation of next-generation passenger and cargo terminals.

Organised by Informa Markets and running from 3 to 5 November, the event has Hong Kong International Airport as its principal partner. It includes conference stages, showcases and activities on master planning, automation, sustainability and multi-modal links.

Organisers said the expo would feature more than 120 exhibitors and expected about 6,000 visitors. New elements include a Low Altitude Economy Pavilion for drone and eVTOL operators, and an African Airport Showcase.
The event is held in Halls 5 and 7 at AsiaWorld-Expo.

zh.headline: 超級樞紐博覽會今起亞洲國際博覽館舉行 聚焦未來交通樞紐
zh.dek: Informa Markets主辦的三日活動由11月3日至5日舉行，香港國際機場為主要夥伴，涵蓋終端設計、自動化及低空經濟。
body: 超級樞紐博覽會2026今日在亞洲國際博覽館開幕，匯聚政府機構、機場營運商、鐵路及物流界，討論下一代客運及貨運終端的設計與營運。
活動由Informa Markets主辦，於11月3日至5日舉行，香港國際機場為主要夥伴。內容包括會議、展示及活動，涉及總體規劃、自動化、可持續發展及多式聯運。
主辦方表示，博覽會有逾120家參展商，預計約6000名觀眾。新元素包括低空經濟館，供無人機及電動垂直起降飛行器營運商參與，以及非洲機場展示。
活動在亞洲國際博覽館5及7號展館舉行。
